channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Larry Bird | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Larry Bird from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cooper Flagg on Larry Bird
item.description:
Cooper Flagg on getting to meet his favorite player Larry Bird:

“I was definitely nervous. I would say I haven’t been shell shocked a lot in my life. I was talking to him like about the difference in the league now between the league back then. But a lot of the messages that, you know, he displayed can be seen through his play, like never giving up, being that ultimate competitor, playing hard on every single possession. And those were kind of the biggest things that he said. As long as you have those couple things of competing and playing hard that you’ll be all right.”

Cooper Flagg on Larry Bird, Mar 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kon Knueppel on Larry Bird
item.description:
Kon Knueppel on his hustle and diving for loose balls:

“There was a quote from Larry Bird... my dad has these sheets of NBA player quotes—good body language, bad body language—and one of them was, 'A guy watching a ball go out of bounds without diving for it makes me sick.'”

Kon Knueppel on Larry Bird, Feb 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chris Finch on Larry Bird
item.description:
“Actually, when I really started to watch basketball … I was probably a secret Celtics fan that time, with Bird.”

Chris Finch on Larry Bird, Nov 30, 2025. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: Cedric Maxwell on Larry Bird
item.description:
“We are totally different people. Larry likes beer. I like sodas. Larry likes to hunt. I like to go to the zoo. He goes to fish, I go to the fish market. Being on the stage with great teams and great players, you can always feel slighted. I understand that but I’m just speaking out on it. “A lot of people don’t like me, they always think I’m complaining or I’m jealous of Larry. I’m not. Larry Bird is one of the greatest players to ever play the game and I appreciate that I played with him. But I’m sure he appreciates the fact he played with me too. But for [the documentary] to paint that picture about what happened and not put this in or that in, it bothered me.”

Cedric Maxwell on Larry Bird, May 11, 2025. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Jayson Williams on Larry Bird
item.description:
It was a night filled with memories, but one moment stood out above all—the presence of Larry Bird.

“I remember walking into the locker room and seeing Coach Bird there,”

Jayson Williams on Larry Bird, Mar 31, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Larry Bird
item.description:
“I want the next generation to view me as that. Wearing a Celtics uniform comes with a lot of pride, and the best Celtic ever is Larry Bird. Even if I never reach that — maybe I do, maybe I don’t — if you aspire to chase that guy, it comes with a level of focus and motivation every single day to be the best you can.”

Jayson Tatum on Larry Bird, Feb 21, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Paul George on Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Paul George:

“Obviously, Anthony Edwards is super talented and is a huge talent going forward, but just how much the game has grown and how far you got to pay dues to those dudes that did it before us, and I think that's just where the translation between that era and his era…They don't really know too much about Magic Johnson and Larry Bird. Obviously, MJ is moving how guys move in this era today, so I think that was kind of like where he was going with it, as far as the movement and the explosiveness, the athleticism, and being able to contort your body.”

Paul George on Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Anthony Edwards, Sep 4, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Isiah Thomas, Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan, Larry Bird
item.description:
Jayson Tatum:

“Isiah Thomas didn't win Finals MVP every time. Tim Duncan didn't win Finals MVP every time. Larry Bird. Steph Curry only has one. Kobe won two out of five championships. As a competitor, you want to win and accomplish everything in front of you, absolutely. But I would not be the slightest bit sad, you know, that I didn't win Finals MVP. I would be ecstatic just to win the Finals.”

Jayson Tatum on Isiah Thomas, Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan, Larry Bird, Jun 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Larry Bird
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on meeting Larry Bird:

“That was crazy to hear him say he was looking forward to meeting me. He’s the ultimate Celtic, so it was an honor to meet him.”

Jayson Tatum on Larry Bird, Feb 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @brohrbach.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Charles Barkley, Joe Dumars, Patrick Ewing, Larry Bird, Robert Parish
item.description:
Miller was a five-time All-Star, with his first All-Star selection coming in 1990 in Miami in just his third NBA season.

“I remember in 1990 walking into the locker room for the first time, and there's Larry (Bird) and there's Isiah (Thomas) and there was Jordan and there was Joe Dumars and there was Robert Parish, there was Charles (Barkley), Patrick (Ewing),”

Reggie Miller on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Charles Barkley, Joe Dumars, Patrick Ewing, Larry Bird, Robert Parish, Feb 16, 2024. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Todd Ramasar on Kevin Pritchard, Chad Buchanan, Donnie Walsh, Larry Bird
item.description:
Ramasar:

“He’s excited. There are a lot of memories up in Toronto, and a lot of good memories. Although things have changed to where he’s been moved, he’s ecstatic about the opportunity ahead of him in Indiana. First of all, it’s a first-class organization. When you look at [President] Kevin Pritchard and [general manager] Chad Buchanan, these are basketball guys with an organization that always has had basketball executives from Larry Bird to Donnie Walsh that have been there. Their front office is first class.”

Todd Ramasar on Kevin Pritchard, Chad Buchanan, Donnie Walsh, Larry Bird, Jan 18, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Kevin McHale, Larry Bird, Robert Parish
item.description:
Klay Thompson:

“To look at us three and think that we've won championships in the same realm as guys like McHale, Bird and Parish or Manu, Tim and Tony... Hopefully, Steph, Klay and Dray will leave a legacy like theydid.”

Klay Thompson on Kevin McHale, Larry Bird, Robert Parish, Dec 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: John Starks on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Larry Bird
item.description:
“He felt like he didn’t need to go chase players to join his team to beat the best because he felt like he was the best, and I think that’s the difference. I think that’s probably going to hurt LeBron when you look at it in that perspective against Michael, Bird, and Magic. Those guys stayed with one team and they won with that team.”

John Starks on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Larry Bird, Sep 6, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird
item.description:
Tracy McGrady:

“You look at some of the greats that have come through this game. And I'm not saying Magic Johnson was lucky, but Magic Johnson played with a lot of freaking Hall of Famers. I'm not saying Larry Bird was lucky either. He played with a lot of Hall of Famers as well. Jordan wasn't so lucky of playing with a lot of Hall of Famers. He just had a great sidekick in Scottie Pippen. But if you look at Jordan before Scottie Pippen became Scottie Pippen, Jordan was just a great individual player. Like,Jordan wasn't getting out of the first round or going deep into the playoffs before Scottie Pippen became Scottie Pippen.”

Tracy McGrady on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Jul 26, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dennis Rodman on Larry Bird
item.description:
“He’s better than Larry Bird … compare him to Larry Bird, I think people would pick him.”

Dennis Rodman on Larry Bird, Jun 26, 2023. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Larry Bird
item.description:
Arenas said.

“So when someone is like, ‘Well, how are you going to leave out like Larry Bird?’ Easy, easy, easy, like I can do that easy.”

Gilbert Arenas on Larry Bird, Sep 5, 2022. Source: ahnfiredigital.com.

item.title: Jim Quinn on Larry Bird
item.description:
Jim Quinn told The Athletic.

“Just as we got towards the end,Alan Cohen, who was part of the group buying the Celtics, said, ‘I’m not going to agree to the deal unless I can be assured that under any circumstances, I can keep Larry Bird.’”

Jim Quinn on Larry Bird, Feb 10, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Cade Cunningham on Larry Bird, Grant Hill
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Cunningham on comparisons to Larry Bird and Grant Hill:

“It’s surreal knowing that they are legends, some of the best guys to ever play the game. I think it gives you more confidence knowing that Weaver is a guy that really knows basketball.”

Cade Cunningham on Larry Bird, Grant Hill, Jul 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Paul Mokeski on Larry Bird, Julius Erving
item.description:
“We would run into Philly with Dr. J. (Julius Erving), the Celtics and Larry Bird and that group, and it was very frustrating.”

Paul Mokeski on Larry Bird, Julius Erving, Jul 19, 2021. Source: Spokesman-Review.

item.title: World B. Free on Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird
item.description:
former Warrior World B. Free said.

“It’s a person that just knows what he’s doing, knows he’s good. Not many guys have it. You know Michael Jordan had it. Magic Johnson. Larry Bird. Dr. J. Allen Iverson. It factors. When you see those guys coming, you know you’re in for a long night.”

World B. Free on Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Apr 13, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Larry Bird
item.description:
Luka, on ABC, asked about recent comparisons to Larry Bird's game:

“More, more games to go. A long time before you can compare me to Larry Bird. I just want to keep hooping, have fun playing basketball.”

Luka Doncic on Larry Bird, Feb 28, 2021. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Shawn Kemp on Larry Bird
item.description:
During a recent appearance on the Knuckleheads podcast with Quentin Richardson & Darius Miles,Kemp recalled a meeting with Bird that has stuck with him to this day.

“We were playing the Boston Celtics, so the great Larry Bird. I'm from Indiana and Larry's from Indiana,”

Shawn Kemp on Larry Bird, Dec 1, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Mavericks coachRick Carlisle on Luka Doncic after exit from playoffs:

“Hell come back next year even better, with something new in his game, the same way as Larry Bird, Magic Johnson and Michael Jordan and all those greats. He has an irrepressible enthusiasm for the game.”

Rick Carlisle on Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Luka Doncic, Aug 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Larry Bird, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Coach Pop on Porter Jr. and Jokic:

“Porter’s a fine young talent and Jokic, he’s like a reincarnation of Larry Bird, he does everything.”

Gregg Popovich on Larry Bird, Nikola Jokic, Aug 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Clyde Drexler on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Larry Bird, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Julius Erving, George Gervin
item.description:
Drexler also offered up suggestions on a handful of other NBA greats.

“And then you've got guys like Dr. J [Julius Erving], Larry Bird, George Gervin, Elgin Baylor, Oscar Robertson, Jerry West. All those guys are in the conversation,and so for people to bring this up today, to me it's just unbelievable. And I love Michael and LeBron. But still, let's not take something away from those other guys who played.”

Clyde Drexler on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Larry Bird, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Julius Erving, George Gervin, May 29, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Ahmad Rashad on Michael Jordan, Larry Bird
item.description:
That's when things got heated.

“Michael and Magic got into it. They were talking back and forth with each other, and it was really funny. I was sitting over there with Larry Bird and we were just watching,”

Ahmad Rashad on Michael Jordan, Larry Bird, May 13, 2020. Source: complex.com.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Tracy McGrady, Taj Gibson, Larry Bird
item.description:
No. 22 Jimmy Butler:

“I played (in Chicago) with one of the toughest individuals I’ve ever played with in my life — Taj Gibson. He taught me so much about how to be a pro. Sometimes people choose numbers because of someone that inspires them, and Taj is one of those people. I wore 33 at Marquette. In high school, I wore No. 1 because of Tracy McGrady. My best friend, who’s a brother to me and (who) I moved in with, was No. 33. And as much as his family had done for me, I chose it because his mom’s favorite player was Larry Bird, and then it kind of stuck. It was all because of Larry Bird and Jordan Leslie.”

Jimmy Butler on Tracy McGrady, Taj Gibson, Larry Bird, Apr 11, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Larry Bird
item.description:
Michael Jordan once said,

“Larry Bird is the greatest trash talker and mind-game player of all time. He taught me everything I know about getting in folks’ heads.”

Michael Jordan on Larry Bird, Apr 10, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Larry Bird
item.description:
says Rick Carlisle, a guard on that Celtics team.

“We didn’t have the internet or Instagram or Twitter where some of these shots could go out in the universe in real time. Otherwise, the legend of Larry Bird would even be bigger than what it is now.”

Rick Carlisle on Larry Bird, Jan 9, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Michael Jordan, Larry Bird
item.description:
Thomas told The Detroit News.

“Still today, it goes Bird, Magic and then it goes to Jordan and it’s almost as if we didn’t exist.“Fortunately for us, the '30 for 30' video was the first time we all collectively got a voice and were able to speak and tell our story. Our story was told so accurately that because of that, history is being corrected. Had it not been for the '30 for 30,' we could have gotten lost in history.”

Isiah Thomas on Michael Jordan, Larry Bird, Apr 1, 2019. Source: Detroit News.
